build_QBottleneck: build a QBottleneck module with specified codebook sizes and hidden dims for vector quantization
build_codebook: build a codebook tensor initialized with uniform or normal distribution for vector quantization
quantize_vectors: quantize prequantized latents to nearest codebook entries using Euclidean distance or probabilistic selection
update_metrics: update codebook hit statistics including perplexity, max hits, and percentage hits across all codebooks
reset_hits: reset all codebook hit counters to zero for fresh metric tracking
